```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# 1. Force RMarkdown to use the Project Root for EVERYTHING
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

# 2. Standard options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# 3. Load Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(writexl)
library(here) 
library(fs) # Highly recommended for directory management

# 4. Define and Create Paths
# By wrapping in here(), we ensure it's relative to .Rproj, not the .Rmd
out_path <- here::here(params$out_dir)

if (!fs::dir_exists(out_path)) {
  fs::dir_create(out_path, recurse = TRUE)
}
```

# Read in baseline data and clean column names
```{r}
# Using here() to anchor the path
bsl_path <- here("Data", "raw", "demographics", "baseline_data.csv")

if (!file.exists(bsl_path)) stop("Check file path: ", bsl_path)

BSL <- read_csv(bsl_path) %>%
  # Gender/Sex Factor
  mutate(gender = factor(sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>%
  # Education Factor
  mutate(education_level = factor(education, 
                                  levels = 1:6, 
                                  labels = c("None", "GCSE", "Alevel", "Undergraduate", "Postgraduate", "Chooseno"))) %>%
  # Marital Factor
  mutate(marital_status = factor(marital, 
                                 levels = 1:6, 
                                 labels = c("single", "married", "divorced", "widowed", "separated", "chooseno"))) %>%

  # Handle Caffeine NAs
  mutate(caffeine = ifelse(is.na(caffeine), 0, caffeine)) %>%
  # Chronotype Category
  mutate(chronotype_cat = case_when(
    chronotype <= 41 ~ "evening",
    chronotype >= 59 ~ "morning",
    chronotype >= 42 & chronotype <= 58 ~ "intermediate"
  ))
```

# Create table for the manuscript
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)

# 1. Final Data Preparation
table_input <- BSL %>%
  mutate(
    gender = factor(sex),
    ethnicity = factor(ethnicity),
    marital_status = factor(marital),
    # Ensure numeric types for precision
    age = as.numeric(age),
    HADS = as.numeric(HADS),
    ISI = as.numeric(ISI),
    caffeine = as.numeric(caffeine),
    chronotype = as.numeric(chronotype),
    # Binary Thresholds
    hads_above_8 = ifelse(HADS >= 8, 1, 0),
    isi_above_11 = ifelse(ISI >= 11, 1, 0),
    caff_low     = ifelse(caffeine < 400, 1, 0),
    caff_high    = ifelse(caffeine >= 400, 1, 0)
  )

# 2. Build the Publication Table
summary_table <- table_input %>%
  select(
    gender, age, ethnicity, education, marital_status, 
    HADS, hads_above_8, 
    ISI, isi_above_11, 
    caffeine, caff_low, caff_high, 
    chronotype, chronotype_cat
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(
      age ~ "continuous",
      HADS ~ "continuous",
      ISI ~ "continuous",
      caffeine ~ "continuous",
      chronotype ~ "continuous",
      hads_above_8 ~ "dichotomous",
      isi_above_11 ~ "dichotomous",
      caff_low     ~ "dichotomous",
      caff_high    ~ "dichotomous"
    ),
    value = list(
      hads_above_8 ~ "1",
      isi_above_11 ~ "1",
      caff_low     ~ "1",
      caff_high    ~ "1"
    ),
    label = list(
      gender ~ "Male, n (%)",
      age ~ "Age (years), mean (SD)",
      ethnicity ~ "Ethnicity, n (%)",
      marital_status ~ "Marital status, n (%)",
      HADS ~ "HADS-D score (Mean, SD)",
      hads_above_8 ~ "HADS-D score ≥8 (n)",
      education ~ "Education level, n (%)",
      ISI ~ "ISI score (Mean, SD)",
      isi_above_11 ~ "ISI score ≥11 (n)",
      caffeine ~ "CCQ-R score (mg/day; Mean, SD)",
      caff_low ~ "CCQ-R score <400mgday (n)",
      caff_high ~ "CCQ-R score ≥400mgday (n)",
      chronotype ~ "MEQ score (Mean, SD)",
      chronotype_cat ~ "Chronotype, n (%)"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
      c(hads_above_8, isi_above_11, caff_low, caff_high) ~ "{n}"
    ),
    # Force 2 decimal places for all continuous variables
    digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 2),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  # Filter to show only 'Male'
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>% filter(!(variable == "gender" & label == "Female"))
  ) %>%
  # Append the Age Range directly under the Age Mean
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      mutate(stat_0 = if_else(variable == "age", 
                              paste0(stat_0, "\n", min(table_input$age, na.rm=T), "-", max(table_input$age, na.rm=T)), 
                              stat_0))
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Characteristic**", stat_0 = "**Value**") %>%
  bold_labels()

summary_table
 # save as word file to output directory
save_as_docx(summary_table, path = here(params$out_dir, "demographics_summary_table.docx"))

```
